notes.title: Full release trailer : EURGAVA - Tomb of Senza "Your days are numbered"
notes.notes:
Watch it on YouTube
https://i.imgur.com/G5B1JZz.png

If you've been playing with the playable demo on gamejolt, you might be better off forgetting everything you know. The story has changed, items works a bit differently, the way you progress is no longer the same, etc.

Full version will be available this year 2019. Exact release date TBA.

Sorry for leaving you all in the dark for too long, but I believe the wait is still worth it.

- Ibrahim Indra Baskara

notes.title: Patch 1.032 - 40% OFF this winter - Happy holidays, happy new year!
notes.notes:
Exactly what it says on the title, guys. Time sure flows fast. This game is 1 year old already.

Patch 1.032 :
Disabled mouse click on Battle Aids, to avoid accidental use during a run. You can still use hotkey QWERTY for them.

Perhaps you're looking forward to the sequel I mentioned in the previous announcement? Then check EURGAVA's faceebook, or my team's patreon:
https://i.imgur.com/2GnZxnU.gif

That's all!
Ibrahim Indra Baskara

notes.title: STEAM Summer Sale, Patch 1.03, and a couple of news...
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/7QdYGoo.jpg

25% OFF. Come and get it!

Today's patch 1.03 should fix a major problem: Enemies not showing during boss waves, making the game unplayable. Apologies to the confused players.

========

As for the news :

1. GAME PRIME ASIA @ Balai Kartini Jakarta, July 29-30th, 2017
Together with my circle, Mozaic Heaven, we will be there as exhibitors. Think you can play the game until you can see one of the ending? Limited edition rewards awaits!

...or maybe you want to complain about this game somehow? Come to the event and perhaps I can guide you out of your confusion.

2. A sequel is in progress!
...No, it will not have the same kind of confusing, button-mashing gameplay. Why? Because you no longer play as a common villager. It will introduce new characters, new places, new role, new story, etc. Pay me a visit @ GAME PRIME ASIA this July if you want to know more about this.

========

Hope you have a good time, Minal Aidin Wal Faizin!
Ibrahim Indra Baskara

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
This patch contains bugfix for :
1. Any left click indicator that stays even after enemy death
2. Disadvantageous status reduction for removing trinket items (as pointed out by Ezechiah Winterspoon in the Steam Community Hub. Many thanks.)

And a rework for some items and a preparation. Example :
Naturewarden Lanki's preparation will now give you another starting trinket item.

Unrelated to the patch, here's a tip for players with problem about double-clicking the indicator :
Try to double-click the indicator as if you are double-clicking a folder in your explorer. Do not move your mouse while you're double-clicking.

If the old problems persist or if there are new bugs, post it in the discussions.
Thank you.

Ibrahim Indra Baskara
